description:
Append an action to the organization's tamper-evident log. Returns the entry with its
entry_hash receipt. Requires the organization API key.

action_type.description: One of: tool_call, data_access, data_change, payment, message, decision, approval, error, other
action_type.title: Action Type

actor.description: Who acted: agent name, model, or user on whose behalf
actor.title: Actor

details.description: Optional structured details (JSON object, under 16 KB)
details.title: Details

outcome.description: One of: success, failure, pending, blocked
outcome.title: Outcome

resource.description: What was acted on: URL, file, record ID, account
resource.title: Resource

stream_id.description: Stream to append to, usually the agent's name, e.g. 'billing-agent'
stream_id.title: Stream Id

summary.description: One-line description of what was done
summary.title: Summary

name: ledger_record_action
title: Record an agent action
